steps.title: Orders flow
steps.lead: 250 orders a second reach a database that can take 300.

steps.title: A report slows the database
steps.lead: A report's heavy query makes every query wait: 1.5 s instead of 20 ms.

steps.title: The service gives up after 1 s
steps.lead: After 1 s the service gives up, and so does every layer above it.

steps.title: Every layer retries, at once
steps.lead: Every layer retries 3 times: one click becomes up to 64 attempts on the database.

steps.title: The database drowns
steps.lead: Queries pile up faster than the database answers: every one times out.

steps.title: The cause is gone, the outage is not
steps.lead: The report stops, but the retries alone keep the database above capacity.

steps.title: Every layer retries, at once
steps.lead: Every layer retries 3 times: one click becomes up to 64 attempts on the database.

steps.title: One layer retries, within a budget
steps.lead: Only the service retries, within a 10% budget: the database sees 1.1 times the load.

steps.title: Slow, but not buried
steps.lead: The database is still slow, but no longer buried under retries.

steps.title: The report stops, the database catches up
steps.lead: The report stops, and with the load near normal the database catches up.

steps.title: Orders flow again
steps.lead: Orders flow again: 250 a second, answered in 20 ms.

clicks.name: Retry at one layer, within a budget
